articles.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
articles.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

articles.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
articles.description: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.

articles.title: Major test for Australia's social media ban begins in High Court
articles.description: Lawyers for Reddit and a digital rights group are arguing the world-leading policy robs children of their right to free communication.

articles.title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating
articles.description: An impasse between the US and Russia at the UN means its peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara has ended after 35 years.
